segments.text:
V. 15.
There is nothing entering into a man from without which can deſile him—Though it is very true, a Man may bring Guilt, which is moral Defilement, upon himſelf, by eating what hurts his Health, or by Exceſs either in Meat or Drink; yet even here the Pollution ariſes from the Wickedneſs of the Heart, and is juſt proportionable to it. And this is all that our LORD aſſerts.
